# contextforge_tool (Data Source)

Data source for looking up a ContextForge tool by ID



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Tool ID for lookup

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `description` (String) Tool description
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the tool is enabled
- `input_schema` (Dynamic) JSON Schema defining tool input parameters
- `name` (String) Tool name
- `tags` (List of String) Tool tags
- `team_id` (String) Team ID
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC3339 format)
- `visibility` (String) Visibility setting (public, private, etc.)
